categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Hajime Advanced Material Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of precision injection molded parts and matching precision injection molds. Its products focus on automotive (including passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and new energy vehicles) and high-end home appliances sectors, providing core functional components with high safety and functionality. The company also explores applications in humanoid robots, energy storage, industrial, medical, and aerospace fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in the application and development of special engineering plastics such as PA, PPS, and PEEK, utilizing precision injection molding technology. It has strong capabilities in custom mold design and development, integrating mold design, manufacturing, and debugging. The production process emphasizes fine management, quality control, and advanced equipment from brands like Sumitomo and Toshiba, ensuring high precision and product quality. Proprietary technologies include vacuum suction, in-mold shearing, hot runner application, and thread twisting techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading global automotive parts suppliers and home appliance manufacturers, including companies like Sanhua Intelligent Controls, Amphenol, Litens, NGK Spark Plug, Stoneridge, Pierburg, Schaeffler, Autoliv, Huayu Pierburg, Magna, Faurecia, Dongfeng Fuji Thomson, Geely, MAHLE, ZF, Gates, Hutchinson, Mubea, and A.O. Smith, Panasonic, Kohler, Noritz, TOTO, Nidec, Duravit, and Rinnai. The main markets served are automotive (especially new energy vehicles) and high-end home appliances, with expanding presence in humanoid robots and other emerging industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Shanghai and a growing production base in Xiangtan, Hunan Province. It serves domestic markets predominantly but also has increasing export sales, accounting for over 12% of revenue. The company is expanding its international market reach, especially in automotive and home appliance sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Hajime Advanced Material Technology Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the upstream to midstream segments of the supply chain as a precision injection molded parts manufacturer and mold developer. It supplies core components to first-tier automotive parts suppliers and home appliance manufacturers, positioning itself as a key tier-2 supplier in the automotive supply chain and a direct supplier to appliance manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes value innovation through product and technology development, focusing on high-value, complex, and reliable precision injection molded products. R&D efforts emphasize new energy vehicle components such as thermal management modules, electronic water pumps, and battery cooling modules, as well as humanoid robot parts. It invests in expanding production capacity, upgrading equipment, and enhancing automation and digital factory capabilities. The company also pursues diversification into energy storage, industrial, medical, and aerospace sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized precision injection molded parts and molds. The company signs framework sales contracts with major customers and recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also earns income from mold sales, recognized either at once upon certification or in stages linked to injection part sales. Additional income sources include investment income from financial products and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the highly fragmented and competitive precision plastic parts industry, with a focus on high-end automotive and home appliance components. It holds a strong market position as a preferred supplier to leading global automotive parts and appliance companies, leveraging its advanced mold design capabilities, product quality, and customer relationships. The industry includes many small and medium enterprises, but the company distinguishes itself through technology, scale, and strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 591.2 million, a 10.59% increase over 2022, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 103.3 million, up 9.62%. The company maintains a net profit margin above 17% and continues to grow its order backlog, especially in new energy vehicle components with orders around RMB 2.5 billion. Total assets reached RMB 1.36 billion, with steady growth in equity and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-precision injection molded parts made from advanced engineering plastics that replace metal components ('plastic instead of steel/copper'), offering superior safety, durability, and performance. Its integrated mold design and manufacturing capabilities, combined with fine production management and strong R&D, enable it to deliver customized, complex, and reliable components that meet stringent automotive and appliance industry standards. This differentiation supports long-term partnerships with leading global customers and drives market share growth.
